title: 800 Series 24" Dishwasher
sub: Stainless steel, pocket handle, top controls
lead: Bosch's 800 Series in fingerprint-resistant stainless steel, with a pocket handle and the controls set into the top edge of the door. It dries with CrystalDry, washes at 42 dBA and carries a third rack.

features.name: CrystalDry
features.line: Bosch's CrystalDry technology turns moisture into heat to dry the whole load, plastics included. Unload it and put it away.

features.name: Quiet at 42 dBA
features.line: Rated at 42 dBA. Run it after dinner while the conversation carries on. InfoLight shines on the floor so you know a cycle is under way.

features.name: Flexible 3rd Rack
features.line: A third rack with sides that fold down, for utensils, ramekins and the small pieces that crowd the racks below. Bosch counts 30% more loading area than its two-rack dishwashers.

features.name: PrecisionWash with PowerControl
features.line: A spray arm goes after the heavily soiled pieces wherever they sit on the bottom rack. Put the roasting pan where it fits.

features.name: AquaStop leak protection
features.line: Bosch's leak protection is on watch around the clock, during a cycle and between them.

also: EasyGlide racks for a smooth glide
Wi-Fi with Home Connect, there if you want it: monitor and control a cycle from a phone
